cost_expenses_amount_check.name: cost_expenses_amount_check
cost_expenses_amount_check.value:
("cost_expenses"."certainty" = 'pendiente' and "cost_expenses"."amount_minor" is null) or
    ("cost_expenses"."certainty" in ('estimado', 'definitivo') and "cost_expenses"."amount_minor" is not null and "cost_expenses"."amount_minor" >= 0)

wholesale_order_costs_currency.name: wholesale_order_costs_currency
wholesale_order_costs_currency.value:
("wholesale_order_costs"."exchange_rate_minor" is null or "wholesale_order_costs"."exchange_rate_minor" > 0)
    and (("wholesale_order_costs"."currency" = 'ARS' and "wholesale_order_costs"."ars_minor" is not null)
      or ("wholesale_order_costs"."currency" = 'USD' and ("wholesale_order_costs"."ars_minor" is null) = ("wholesale_order_costs"."exchange_rate_minor" is null)))
